apps.name: Toolbelt
apps.subtitle: Home-lab and hub companion
apps.localizedDescription:
Companion for the Developer Toolbelt. Shows local service health, the unified alert inbox, and a read-only finance glance, reaching the home lab over Tailscale.

Read-only for finance by design: the desktop auto-trader's arming, kill-switch and daily-loss guarantees hold because there is exactly one path to an order. This app is not a second one.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Reaches the Toolbelt gateway on your tailnet.
